page: Amazon Web Services i7ie.48xlarge is a storage-optimized instance running on the AWS Nitro System. It is powered by 3.2 GHz Intel Xeon 8559C processors providing 192 dedicated vCPUs across 96 physical cores with simultaneous multithreading enabled. The memory subsystem consists of 1,536 GB of DDR5 RAM operating at 6 GHz, yielding an allocation of 8 GB per vCPU. Hardware acceleration capabilities include Intel Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX) and AVX-512 support alongside 320 MB of shared L3 cache. No discrete GPU acceleration is included.

Storage density is a distinguishing attribute of the platform, supplying 120,000 GB of direct-attached NVMe SSD capacity. Network architecture offers a 200 Gbps baseline bandwidth to support continuous high-volume ingress and egress without external link congestion.

Benchmark evaluations indicate superior parallel computational throughput, with multi-core stress-ng tests, multi-threaded bzip3 decompression, and overall PassMark CPU scores landing in the top 10% tier. Storage and memory subsystem benchmarks show over 571 GB/s in large-block read memory bandwidth and top-tier database transaction capabilities, including 203.2 million operations per second in Redis SET workloads. Single-core stress-ng execution registers in the middle 50%, illustrating an architecture tailored for aggregate throughput across high thread counts rather than individual core burst speed.

By consolidating 120 TB of NVMe SSD capacity and 1.5 TB of memory on a single node, i7ie.48xlarge provides high resource efficiency for horizontally demanding applications. It is suited for bare-metal replacement clusters, distributed databases, search indexing engines, extensive data warehouses, and high-throughput real-time stream processing.
description: Amazon Web Services i7ie.48xlarge is a high-density, storage-optimized instance designed for data-intensive enterprise workloads. Powered by the Intel Xeon 8559C processor running on the AWS Nitro System, it delivers 192 dedicated vCPUs (96 physical cores) at 3.2 GHz, 1,536 GB of 6 GHz DDR5 memory, and 120,000 GB of local NVMe SSD storage. The platform integrates a 200 Gbps baseline network interface and includes Intel AMX and AVX-512 instruction support, though it lacks discrete GPUs. In benchmark assessments, the instance achieves top-decile multi-core processing, exceptional memory bandwidth, and outstanding database transactional throughput, demonstrating over 200 million Redis SET operations per second. While single-thread metrics fall in the median range, the combination of substantial storage capacity, massive memory footprint, and high-bandwidth interconnect makes i7ie.48xlarge an efficient platform for large-scale relational databases, real-time analytics engines, distributed search clusters, and high-volume data warehousing.
